annotations.title: Create or change an in-app product

description: Creates an in-app product or subscription in one store (leave productId out and put it in values), or changes one, straight to the store (needs a token allowed to submit). values: kind (subscription, consumable, non_consumable; on create), productId (on create: Apple takes letters, numbers, periods, underscores; Play lowercase), price (US dollars such as "4.99": Apple picks its nearest price point at or above, Play converts it for every country), period (subscriptions: P1W P1M P2M P3M P6M P1Y), trial (P3D P1W P2W P1M, or null to remove), listings ({ locale: { name, description } } in the store's own codes; Hebrew is "he" at Apple, "iw-IL" at Play; Apple names take 35 characters and descriptions 55, Play 55 and 200), and on the App Store referenceName, group (an existing group ID from ploa_product_get) or groupName (a new group), reviewNote, familySharable; on Play basePlanId. From an agent, a new product, a price or a free trial waits for a person's approval, since it sets what people pay; names and notes go straight through. An App Store subscription's price or free trial is set country by country and takes a few minutes: it answers with a job, which ploa_product_job follows.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

productId.description: The product to change; leave out to create.

name: ploa_product_save
